title: Create: Addons Improved
description: Modifies the recipes for certain Create addons to be more vanilla-like.
body:
# Create: Addons Improved

This datapack aims to remove and revamp recipes from several Create addons in order
to make them more streamlined and vanilla-like.

# Affected Addons

### Create: New Age

New Age's "monkey edition" is too limiting, as it removes thorium duplication in mixers, advanced motors and motor extensions. This datapack instead makes the following changes:

- Removes energizers and all forms of overcharged ores. All recipes use create-specific
  blocks instead without relying on a new mechanic.
- Adds a crafting recipe for regular magnetite and revamps the recipes for other magnetite types to be more create-oriented.
- In the original version, leather blocks radiation from reactors. This is changed to netherite, which acts more like lead in the real world.
- Makes acquiring certain blocks (like reactor casing) slightly more challenging without making it a chore.
- Adds a copper sheet requirement to all overcharged wire recipes.

### Create: Power Loader

We believe that Power Loader's recipes are adequately difficult and do not need changes, but the main issue is that crying obsidian cannot be crafted.

- Adds a recipe for crying obsidian (by splashing regular obsidian).
